clips.title: 网球名将沃兹尼亚奇谈温网：中央公园草地赛首秀
title_lines: 温网中央公园草地赛首秀
吸引美国球迷，推广网球文化

subtitles.en: It's incredible. It's, of course, trying to expand and grow into a different market as well and bringing it to America, which is a very important market for Wimbledon and get the American fans involved.
subtitles.zh: 太棒了。温网正努力拓展新市场，把赛事带到美国这个重要市场，让美国球迷参与进来。

subtitles.en: And also for people who've never had a chance to be at Wimbledon to actually bring it here, bring it to Central Park.
subtitles.zh: 也让从未亲临温网的人有机会体验，把它带到中央公园。

subtitles.en: I mean, it looks beautiful. Everything is set up by the same way as it is in London.
subtitles.zh: 场地布置得很美，和伦敦一模一样。

subtitles.en: So you have the groundskeepers from London have come here to set up the court and make it proper and make it perfect and just the way it looks. It's beautiful and we're so excited to be here.
subtitles.zh: 伦敦的场地维护人员专程过来布置球场，确保一切完美。太美了，我们很兴奋。

subtitles.en: This is the first time we get to play on grass in Central Park and I think it's going to be a really fun event.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们第一次在中央公园的草地上打球，一定会很有趣。

subtitles.en: What exactly is the aim here? I mean, are they just trying to attract a broader audience, a broader international audience?
subtitles.zh: 具体目标是什么？是想吸引更广泛的国际观众吗？

subtitles.en: I mean, we do actually have a big tournament that goes on here in the US every year, the US open.
subtitles.zh: 美国每年都有大型赛事，比如美网。

subtitles.en: I think it's trying to just get Wimbledon outside of the UK and expand and look into
subtitles.zh: 我认为是想让温网走出英国，扩大影响力。

subtitles.en: getting more people involved, get the kids involved and also just kind of Wimbledon is obviously such an iconic event.
subtitles.zh: 让更多人参与，尤其是孩子。温网是标志性赛事。

subtitles.en: A little bit like the Masters, but at the same time you want to make people feel a part of the event and just get a little taste of what it's like being there
subtitles.zh: 有点像大师赛，但同时也想让人有参与感，体验现场氛围。

subtitles.en: and maybe hopefully it will attract people to make the trip over there as well and go see it and go be part of it.
subtitles.zh: 希望这能吸引人们前往那里，亲眼看看并参与其中。

subtitles.en: Well, there's plenty of interest in the court that we've set up here and you can see people milling around and taking photos.
subtitles.zh: 我们搭建的球场吸引了很多人的兴趣，可以看到人们四处走动拍照。
